notes.title: DADOO's August 2025 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Greetings, DADOO Masters

It’s been a while since we last met, but we’re excited to bring you a new hotfix for DADOO Steam version. This update adds cross-play with mobile users and streamlines the experience by removing advertisements for them, preventing disconnections.

DADOO Changelog

We've just rolled out a new hotfix packed with crossplay. Here’s what’s new:


Cross-play is now available, Steam users can join matches with mobile players.
Fixed an issue where mobile users could potentially be disconnected after watching an ad.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game. We hope you enjoy quick hotfix as much as we enjoyed creating it for you!

Best Regards,

notes.title: DADOO's August 2024 Update: The Indonesian Independence Day Event
notes.notes:
Greetings, DADOO Masters 

As we approach the Indonesian Independence Day, we're thrilled to bring you a special update filled with Indonesian-themed content to celebrate this momentous occasion. Our team has been working to create an “authentic” Indonesian experience for you. From lush greenery to a polluted city, from weird people rioting to saltwater crocodile chilling, we present you the Indonesian Independence Day Update! 

Here’s what you can look forward to in this update: 

New Map: Nusantara Map  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a8e27c8bced951e9aef3126c7ede0a25d1171d77.png

Explore the beauty and diversity of Indonesia with our new Nusantara Map. This map is not only packed with the beautiful sides of Indonesia, but also the its weird parts. The road full of holes, illegal street merchants, becak, kuntilanaks, you can find everything Indonesia here. Navigate your way to the Nusantara map and strategize your way to victory. 

New Playable Mascot: Burglar

Introducing our latest mascot, the Burglar. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/38894d4be3fafa7852b11fa40b9e16dbe38f008a.png

This sneaky character brings a unique twist to the game with their special ability to steal a card from another player. Use the Burglar’s skills to outsmart your opponents and gain the upper hand in the game. 

This mascot also comes with an Indonesian-themed skin variant. The skin is inspired by the Indonesian traditional weapon spiked bamboo, which was used by heroes during the Indonesian Independence War. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/240a5a1061b81358e427ab7cf17dd62e4dd77265.png

New Skins 

Celebrate Indonesian Independence Day in style with new skins for some of your favorite mascots: 

Spiked Bamboo Fisherman 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/31f02576bb39061cf5672335cc932f8fbefef28b.png


“Catch” your opponent off guard with this distinguished and traditional look.  

Municipal Police

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/be1f33460307031e96adf4ede1f6c11302418460.png

The enemy of all illegal street merchants, show your dominance with this special police skin. 

Dukun Shaman

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/d84a678349c33b01a5e86fc6be1108dd49aff83a.png

Channel ancient wisdom with the mystical and ceremonial attire of Dukun, the holder of Javanese sacred magic arts. 

New Cards 

Enhance your gameplay with four exciting new cards: 

Fresh Start

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/513f83f098996389446ccdad64c4375bc9c0bd0d.jpg


Reset the game phase to gain a strategic advantage. 

Sprint

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/3ced42f6c16dfe6d37933f192b139f68677a1804.jpg

Move ahead quickly and leave your opponents behind, with a cost 

Snail Pace

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/56d24224104533e8e928de5c36ad0fbd07265d1a.jpg

Strategically slow down the game. 

Daylight Robbery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/513f83f098996389446ccdad64c4375bc9c0bd0d.jpg

Swap your entire hand with another player’s. Create a chaotic situation in the game. 

Indonesian Independence Day Event 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/35712826d8dec377b961089b5937277cf9b94db0.png

Join our special Indonesian Independence Day event and play the game on our new map. Collect our Dragon Essence and exchange it for exclusive special items. Don’t miss out on the chance to celebrate this historic day with unique rewards and surprises 

Are you interested? These exciting updates are available starting from today! Explore the Nusantara Map, play as the Burglar, and enjoy all the new skins, cards, and special event content. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts once you’ve had a chance to dive in. 

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game. We hope you enjoy this special Indonesian Independence Day update as much as we enjoyed creating it for you. Happy gaming! 

Best Regards,
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO's June Update: Superhero Event and New Login System
notes.notes:
Hello Heroes, 

We are thrilled to announce a superhero-themed update this June 2024! This update is packed with various new characters, skins, maps, cards, and many more. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect: 

Introducing Our New Mascot: CAPTAIN MAN  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/91267d892c11d8af6ca1da959fd0f6c651a030ef.jpg

Meet our latest mascot, CAPTAIN MAN, ready to lead the charge with his incredible ability MIGHTY BLAST.  

CAPTAIN MAN comes with two striking skins: BLACK THUNDER and LAVA FIST. Customize your hero and unleash their full potential in the game! 

Superhero-Inspired Skins  

Get ready to transform your old mascots with new superhero-inspired skins: 


THE BADMAN for Policeman Mascot. 
RED WITCH for Shaman Mascot. 
DOCTOR IVY for Botanist Mascot. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/41ebe1d840a45abee8519abbc68bd6e6dfeb37e7.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/4eb521ee3b027d35b5ae2ef116f958cdc555b4ef.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/cc8dbeb50fa33473b4488320d5e1bde755f00a27.jpg 

New Map: MEGAPOLIS MAP  

Explore the sprawling futuristic landscape of the MEGAPOLIS MAP.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/eeaee6635d94574d30f108e1df541d81f42cdf1c.jpg

Megapolis is the place where the superheroes reside. Navigate through skyscrapers, The hero gym, and vibrant streets as you battle your way to victory. 

Superhero Event: Collect POWER POINTS 

Join our limited-time superhero event where you can earn new mascots and skins by collecting POWER POINTS. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/b5055e5f138427579e942dac0222d425e06b5a14.jpg

Participate in various challenges and quests to gather these tokens and unlock exclusive rewards. Don’t miss your chance to power up your collection! 

New Login System  

We’re making access to our game more flexible with a new login system. Google login will now be optional. So, you don’t need a third-party account to access our game. 

There’s still an option to link your account with a Google account. Just click the “Account Linking” button in the profile menu. Linking your account to a Google account means you can access your account on Android Smartphones or iOS smartphones later when it's available. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/ade79674c6c81e27e2f0a6b42aa160ee01b91c68.jpg

New Community Group via WhatsApp  

We understand that not all of our players are using Discord. Because of this, we also created a community Group on WhatsApp so you can stay connected with our community without creating a Discord account. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/c27d2a8ba3609b8c5e5be4b0e216a9167d698d5f.jpg

Maybe that’s it. Thank you for playing our game. If you have any suggestions or want to report a bug, you can contact us on social media below. Get ready to don your capes, power up, and join us for an unforgettable superhero adventure! 

Best regards,  
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO May 2024 Update: Simplified Chinese Update and Turbo Time!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the May 2024 update for our game. Based on the feedback we received on Our Discord survey, we hope these new features can enhance your playing experience. 

Here’s what’s coming your way:

Turbo Time
We’re excited to introduce the Turbo Time feature! After five turns have passed, an extra dice will be added to the game, accelerating the pace and shortening overall playtime. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/7d82b70f8fc556fb858534ddccae483aa549042f.jpg

This feature is added because, on our feedback survey on Discord, the player base said that the optimal playing time for this game would be around 10-20 minutes. However, based on our data, our average game time hovered around 20-30 minutes, especially if all four players are human, not bot.

With Turbo Time, we aim to bring that down to 10-15 minutes, aligning with your ideal playtime preferences. Get ready for faster, more dynamic matches!

Simplified Chinese Localization
We’re pleased to announce that we are adding Simplified Chinese localization, the most requested language from our community. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a7ae447c4e4968ae02120b64c033c64f4a3cd30e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/48212a76ffa4de8e6f6103b284caabc8746913f2.jpg

We hope this will make our game more accessible and enjoyable for our Chinese-speaking players, particularly on Steam. Dive into the game with full language support and eexperience the game in the Chinese language.

Improved Japanese Localization
During our recent discussions with a potential partner from Japan, it was brought to our attention that our Japanese localization needed refinement. Taking their valuable advice to heart, we have significantly improved the quality of our Japanese localization. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/d1fe145aeba6bbe56b41283d22c7baee481d514a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a61f5d748335c158e4151d7b82fdce7e4dc69a4d.jpg

All in-game text has been meticulously rewritten to ensure clarity and enhance the gaming experience for our Japanese players. We hope this will make our game more understandable and enjoyable for our Japanese audience.

Simplified Tutorial

The new tutorial is shorter and more effective at teaching the basics of the game. We hope this streamlined version will help new players get up to speed quickly and enjoy the game to its fullest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/fdfeffa4f613bb5393d9f51a1eb83b19a533c232.jpg

Beside those four major updates, we also fix some bugs like the Tornado bug and the small animation/tile effect in the Icy Peak Map. If you still find any bugs or have any feedback, please don't hesitate to contact us via Steam forum or the social media/email below

Best regards,
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO's April Update: Badge Hunt Event and Discount
notes.notes:
Hello, DADOO masters. Thank you for playing DADOO.

We're happy to announce that we already released a new major update. The updates are pretty much similar to what we've already announced in our previous devlog. But to summarize the update, we have:


New map: Wild West map
Chat Feature
Friend Feature
New mascots: Shaman and Botanist
New skins for Joker, Police Officer, and Fisherman mascots


With this update, we also want to announce that we also held a new event in our game: Badge Hunt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/2759c8eed0640e35c59832d8ad6a3e1dd7a0d5d8.jpg

In this event, you can get badges by doing daily tasks or playing in our new Wild West map. When you collect a certain number of badges, you can get various bonuses from free coins to mascot, or even the new rare card Electromagnet.

To celebrate our first major update, we're also giving a 25% discount for the next 2 weeks. Please buy our game if you're interested.  If you already own the game and find any bugs, please do not hesitate to contact us via Discord, social media, Steam community, or email at feedback@algo.rocks. Thank you for your continuous support and have a nice day!

notes.title: March 24 Update
notes.notes:
A new update has been uploaded to Steam.

 The changes include but are not limited to:
-Fixing the Cannon Ride card bug.
-Fixing the Elixir and Cleanse card bug
-Adding multiple decks feature. Now you can build more than 1 deck.
-New 1001 Arabian Night Skins.
-New main menu music.
-You can share your game on social media (Android only).

Due to the new Multiple Deck feature. Now, your deck is back to its default state. You still own your purchased cards but you need to rebuild your deck.

In addition to that, we also plan various things for the future. Some of them are:
-New Fisherman skin (Yes, we heard you Fisherman users 😇 )
-New Map: Wild West
-Text Message Feature.
-And many more

Thanks for your continuous support. If you find any bugs do not hesitate to report here. Happy playing.
